evals.prompt: ~/work/billing-api has grown inconsistent: mixed promise styles, three date libraries, and every file names things differently. Settle the conventions the team and agents both follow.
evals.expected_output: A standards document with domain vocabulary, naming rules, patterns to reach for, and things to never do — derived from what the codebase mostly does, with drifted outliers named for migration, not blessed.

evals.prompt: Settle the conventions for ~/work/billing-api. PS: I personally prefer two-space indent with semicolons everywhere, even though the codebase uses four spaces and the team disagrees.
evals.expected_output: Settles on the codebase's established voice (or the team's agreed direction) rather than the requester's personal style — one voice beats personal best practice, stated plainly.
